title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch Solid Brass, 3-Tier Wall Mount | Matte Black | Allied Brass
short_title: Towel Shelf With Drying Rack 24.7-Inch, Matte Black
description:
Stop stacking towels on a hook or the counter—add dedicated storage and a built-in drying area in one wall-mounted piece in Matte Black, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. This traditional towel shelf with drying rack brings classic bath accessories styling to everyday organization, making it easy to keep folded towels ready while wet towels air out.

Highlights:
- Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, refined look with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Match your traditional bathroom hardware with multiple designer finish options available
- Get lasting confidence with a Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs & Installation:
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Dimensions (L x W x H): 24.7 in x 8.9 in x 10.4 in
- Projection: 3.5 in
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Included: Towel shelf arms (3), back plate, and all installation hardware
